title: Distributed Cross-Channel Hierarchical Aggregation for Foundation Models
problem: Tokenizing and aggregating multi-channel images for foundation models is compute-intensive
motivation: Vision-based scientific foundation models need efficient processing of high-channel-count imagery (hyperspectral, weather)
method: D-CHAG processes multi-channel image data in hierarchical stages, combining channels progressively rather than all at once. Each stage is designed to work with distributed computing techniques like tensor parallelism (splitting model layers across GPUs) and model sharding (dividing computation across multiple processors). This alignment between the hierarchical processing and distributed computing reduces memory overhead and communication costs between devices.
key_novelty: Distributing the stage-by-stage channel aggregation across multiple processors for multi-channel vision transformers reduces memory use by 75% and doubles processing speed.
